C-6 Delphi: For purposes of the Plan only, and in accordance with the applicable memorandum of understanding entered into between GM and the UAW during 2019 negotiations, those individuals who meet one of the criteria below shall be eligible for benefits.

(a) Former General Motors Employees who are now “Covered Employees” as defined in the Term Sheet – Delphi Pension Freeze and Cessation of OPEB, and GM Consensual Triggering of Benefit Guarantees, who are receiving any pension benefits from the GM Hourly-Rate Employees Pension Plan other than deferred vested benefits.

(b) Individuals currently married to those eligible under C-6(a) providing that such spouse provides to the plan administrator acceptable proof of marriage to the retiree for at least one year before the death of the retiree.

(c) Surviving Spouses of those eligible under C-6(a) only if such spouse is eligible for a surviving spouse benefit under the GM Hourly-Rate Employees Pension Plan.
